extracted.name: One Pan Pesto Chicken and Vegetables
extracted.description: My favorite thing about this easy baked Pesto Chicken and Vegetables is that it's all made in one pan! A healthy 30 minute meal for quick weeknight dinners.
ingredient_lines: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts (, cut into bite-size pieces)
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, combine the chicken, veggies, and pesto until the chicken and veggies are coated well with pesto.
Transfer mixture to a large sheet pan and bake for 15-20 minutes. If desired drizzle with mozzarella cheese during the last 5 minutes of baking.
